resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record maps the association's Abandoned to gone. Firelookout.com's 1936 line says the crow's nest was still there, with no separate date. Neither source says gone, so status is set to unknown.

notes_for_editor: Status: the record says gone, but the association's own column reads Abandoned (its rule maps that to gone), and firelookout.com's 1936 line says the crow's nest was still there, with no separate date. Story and facts set status to unknown. A recent dated photo or a Kootenai National Forest record would settle it. The 1936 year rests on firelookout.com alone. The Lincoln County list prints a 1936 tree crow's nest directly under the Bear Creek Ridge name, so check the Bear Creek Ridge record for a swapped year. Kind is platform in the record (the association says Crowsnest); confirm whether a crow's nest counts as a structure under the 2026-10-08 rule. No staffing, access, visit, fire or photo facts found. Two WebSearch calls found no Forest Service or NRHP page for this site. Record elevation 5625 ft (1714.5 m) matches firelookout.com; coordinates match the association list.
